lookback_summary: What a weekend we had! The model really nailed the Fulham vs Man United match, predicting a Not Home outcome which ended in a draw, so that was a tick in the right box. However, Leeds vs Crystal Palace was a real head-scratcher; the model thought it would lean Home, but it ended up in a stalemate—had to eat humble pie on that one. On the flip side, it got the Man City win right, predicting Home, and boy did they deliver with a thrilling 5-3 victory! Unfortunately, not everything went the model's way as it missed the mark on Everton's win and Brighton's surprising dominance over Arsenal. All in all, a mixed bag, but some solid calls kept the weekend interesting!
